title: A worker's gotcha becomes team knowledge
trigger: a worker hits a gotcha and keeps working

steps.text: At the end of a turn, after ~150k tokens of growth since its last entry, the plugin flushes.

check.note: onTurnEnded returns unless tokens - lastJournal >= everyTokens (150000 default, index.ts:70), journal.ts:114-117@83a5621; journaling agents only.

steps.text: The worker's own model writes the entry, with only the sections that have content; a NOTHING_TO_SAVE reply writes nothing. (session.generate is meant to add no turn to the session.)

check.note: generate(FLUSH_PROMPT) journal.ts:120@83a5621; prompt asks only sections with content; NOTHING_TO_SAVE skips write (121-122). "meant to add no turn" matches the stated intent (journal.ts:4-5); host behaviour not checkable here.

steps.text: The plugin appends it with `coordlite journal`.

check.note: index.ts:78 -> `coordlite journal` (__main__.py:107-108) -> INSERT journal views.py:585@83a5621 (also session_id, agent, tokens); same-session dup within 60 s skipped (580-584). Pin governs the table.

steps.text: After that flush the plugin asks the master to compile if 8 or more entries are pending, or if it is past 18:00 and nothing was compiled today; at most once every 2 hours, and never if no session flushes.

check.note: maybeCompile journal.ts:86-96@83a5621, called after a flush (130): 2 h rate limit, pending>=compileMin(8) or hour>=18 with nothing compiled today; needs known coordinator session.

steps.text: The master starts knowledge-compile in a background subagent, which loads the backlog.

check.note: compileText asks for knowledge-compile in a background subagent (journal.ts:51-53); journal_pending server.py:222-225@83a5621 reads uncompiled rows incl. body (views.py:596-600).

steps.text: The compiler checks the claim at HEAD and writes or edits a lesson under the right concept.

check.note: node_create views.py:87@83a5621 is the create path (edits via node_edit views.py:119); HEAD check and lesson-under-concept are knowledge-compile SKILL.md:19-24,46. Convention pin fits.

steps.text: It records a receipt on each node it touched.

check.note: receipt_add views.py:264-275@83a5621 -> add_receipt inserts receipt and moves node.touched_at (db.py:367); also a change row. Skill step 3 per node.

steps.text: It marks the entries compiled, naming the nodes they went into.

check.note: UPDATE journal SET compiled_at, compiled_by, compiled_into WHERE id IN (...) AND compiled_at IS NULL, views.py:609@83a5621.

steps.text: The next session to start gets the knowledge index, now including the lesson, in its system prompt.

check.note: systemFor snapshots `coordlite index` once per session (refreshed after compaction), journal.ts:147-154@83a5621, pushed via context hook index.ts:92-95; lesson shows in Recently changed knowledge (views.py:682-684).
